

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Galen, Secret Apprentice” to “Galen Marek, Starkiller”. The lore was removed in the master. References in game text were updated. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state.
